components.css: :host{--paper:#fcfcfa;--ink:#1d2230;--muted:#5f6470;--line:#e6e2dd;--ms-rule:#e0573a;--ms-soft:#f1cbbf;--ms-tint:#fbefea;--ms-text:#b23d1d;font:15px/1.6 'Pretendard','Malgun Gothic',system-ui,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink)} .ds-phase{border:1px solid var(--ms-soft);background:var(--paper);max-width:320px}.ds-phase-head{position:relative;padding:18px 20px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ms-rule)}.ds-phase-head:hover{background:var(--ms-tint)}.ds-phase-head h3{margin:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-phase-head p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.ds-badge{position:absolute;right:20px;top:18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}.ds-mini{display:flex;margin-top:12px}.ds-mini span{width:14px;height:14px;border:1px solid var(--ms-rule);margin-left:-1px}.ds-mini span:first-child{margin-left:0}.ds-mini span.on{background:var(--ms-rule)}.ds-tasks{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:5px 18px}.ds-tasks li{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:18px 0;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}.ds-tasks li+li{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.ds-tasks input{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;flex:0 0 20px;width:20px;height:20px;margin:2px 0 0;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);background:var(--paper);display:grid;place-content:center;border-radius:0}.ds-tasks input:checked{background:var(--ms-rule);border-color:var(--ms-rule)}.ds-tasks input:checked::after{content:'';width:9px;height:5px;border-left:2px solid var(--paper);border-bottom:2px solid var(--paper);transform:translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg)}.ds-tasks input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
The free default theme treats the project as a Korean manuscript sheet. Each task is one ruled square; finishing the task fills its square in vermilion. Progress is read by counting filled cells, not by a percentage or a large number. Cells are grouped by phase, so the strip of squares in the overview and the smaller strip under each phase heading show the same thing at two scales.

The page is quiet, near-white paper with blue-black ink. Vermilion is the ruling colour of the sheet. It draws structure (the double rule under the top bar, section rules, cell borders) and the done state, and nothing else. Hierarchy comes from weight (700 against 400) and position, not from size. Structure is made of 1px rules and whitespace. There are no shadows, no background textures and no rounded corners.

The theme lives under the appearance key `lime`, a legacy slug kept for stored user preferences. The paid themes (retro desktop, blueprint, receipt, chalkboard) and the completion celebration dialog are separately owned skins. This system does not cover them, and they stay unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: One task = one square cell; a finished task's cell is filled vermilion with a paper-coloured check.
Vermilion is reserved for ruling and completion.
Weight-led hierarchy on a single Korean system sans; no display numbers.
Hairline rules, a double rule as the sheet's header line, square corners everywhere.
A full dark counterpart: same roles, re-tuned values.

rules.name: The Ruling Colour Rule
rules.body: Vermilion means the sheet's ruling or "done". It never marks a warning, a promotion or a decorative accent.

rules.name: The One Wash Rule
rules.body: Every hover, selected and scheduled state uses the same vermilion wash with ink text. Never invert to solid ink on hover.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Only two weights exist: 400 and 700. Do not add a size step to show importance. Make the text Bold or move it.

rules.name: The No Display Number Rule
rules.body: Quantities appear as the cell strip plus one sentence or as 15px Bold inline counts. Never set a big KPI figure. The percentage figure is hidden in this theme, and the visual bar is replaced by an accessible visually-hidden progressbar.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If an element needs separation, give it a rule of the right weight and colour, never a shadow or a tinted elevation layer.

dos: **Do** represent each task as exactly one ruled cell, and fill it only when the task is done.
**Do** keep vermilion for rules and the done state, and render vermilion text as vermilion-text on the wash.
**Do** rank with 700 against 400 on the one system stack, with tabular numerals.
**Do** separate with 1px rules (vermilion, then soft ruling, then pencil line) and a double rule at sheet headers.
**Do** use the vermilion wash with ink text for every hover and selected state.
**Do** draw icons as 16px inline SVG with square caps in the current colour.
donts: **Don't** add drop shadows, hard offset shadows, or background grid textures behind cards. The cell strip and calendar grid are the only grids.
**Don't** set display-size numbers, percentages as heroes, or progress bars in this theme.
**Don't** add English monospace kickers or eyebrow labels above Korean headings.
**Don't** use text glyphs (arrows, check marks, plus and minus) as icons.
**Don't** use acid lime or any second accent hue. The legacy `lime` key is only a storage slug.
**Don't** restyle the paid themes or the completion celebration from this system. They are separately owned skins.
